board.bio:
Dr. Santosh Kumar Yadav is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Operations
and IT at the Faculty of Management, IBS Hyderabad, IFHE, India. He brings over three years of teaching experience as a Lecturer at the Patel Group of Institutions, Indore, and more than two years of experience as an Academic
Associate (AA) in the Operations
Management and Quantitative Techniques (OM & QT) area at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore. A science graduate with a postgraduate degree in management, Dr. Santosh Kumar Yadav has actively participated in national and international conferences, presenting his
research both in India and abroad. Recently he has received SAP University Alliances Educational Excellence Membership Award
2026 on behalf of IFHE Hyderabad at Jakarta. He is a certified ERPsim Level 1 Instructor and GBI S/4 HANA 4.2 and SAP Analytics Cloud trainer and holds lifetime memberships in several professional bodies
including the Society of Operations
Management (SOM), the Operational Research Society of
India (ORSI), the Analytics Society of India (ASI), and AIMS International.
